svg.title: Auto Dream: Extract, Evolve, and Link
svg.desc: Changed daily notes become Personal, Procedure, or Wiki memory, evolve through four actions, and gain Wikilinks and source links during consolidation.
svg.text: Auto Dream: Extract, Evolve, and Link
Turn scattered daily notes into classified, evolving, connected long-term knowledge
Merge the same abstraction; retain reusable memory units
1 Classify into three long-term memory types
2 Search all Digest types: evolve matches and link related nodes
3 Add Auto Links in the same write
Related Digest nodes → Wikilinks in the body
